title: KYC Management System
seo_title: KYC Management System | Achala IT Solutions
meta_description: KYC Management System verifies documents and identity in about 5 minutes — 60% faster than manual onboarding cycles.

blocks.x: Customer onboarding in about 5 minutes. KYC Management System combines document verification with face recognition to cut onboarding time by 60% against manual cycles.

KYC Management System takes an applicant from submission to verified customer: documents are read and checked automatically, identity is matched through face recognition, and questionable cases go to a review queue with everything the reviewer needs in one view.

items: IDs and proofs read, validated and cross-checked automatically
Selfie-to-document identity match with liveness checks
Unclear cases routed to humans with full context attached
Every verification step logged for regulators and audits

blocks.x: The platform runs document and face models in a controlled serving environment; no applicant data trains shared models. Data retention follows your jurisdiction's rules, and reviewer actions are logged end to end.

items: Verification models run inside your perimeter
Applicant data is never used to train external models
Documents and biometric data kept per policy, then purged
Complete verification trails, exportable on demand

blocks.x: Banks, insurance companies, telecom operators and any business with a regulated onboarding duty. Published deployments report verification in about 5 minutes, 60% faster than manual processing.
Book a briefing with the KYC team. We will map your onboarding flow and show where the 60% time saving comes from.
